[ASSISTANT_SAID] Simulations and Laboratories: Medical students can use virtual reality simulations to practice complex surgical procedures in a safe environment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Language Learning: Augmented reality and virtual reality can be used to teach foreign languages in an immersive and interactive way.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Historical Reenactments: Virtual reality can provide immersive historical reenactments for students to explore different historical events.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Collaborative Learning: Virtual reality allows students to work on projects together in the same virtual space, regardless of their physical location.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] All-In-One Learning: Virtual and augmented reality can promote inclusive learning by allowing students from different countries and cultures to learn together.
